observations: A flat white game console sits on cardboard boxes, photographed through what looks like a shop window.
Two red-and-white boxed 'Wireless Controller' sets (generic third-party brand, not Sony DualShock) are placed on top of the console.
A power cable (UK-style plug) and what appears to be an HDMI cable are coiled on top of the console.
No model number, serial sticker, or rear port panel is visible.
Watermark reads 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' over the image.
The console's shape is a single flat slab typical of a PS4 Slim; the distinctive three-tier stepped body of a PS4 Pro is not clearly visible in this angle.

read_from: photo 0 (no visible model/serial text; body shape ambiguous between Slim and Pro)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a flat white console; no model text visible and shape resembles PS4 Slim more than the layered PS4 Pro design, so the Pro claim cannot be confirmed.
No power-on, boot screen, or gameplay footage shown.

risks.risk: Console may actually be a PS4 Slim or base PS4 rather than the claimed Pro, which changes its market value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear panel/model sticker (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) or the console powered on showing the system settings model info.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard PS4 (non-Pro), the cheaper tier

risks.risk: No proof the unit powers on or reads discs/games correctly.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and loading a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: Controllers shown are generic third-party 'Wireless Controller' units, not official Sony pads, so stated controller value/quality is unclear.
risks.proof: Photo of the controller itself out of the box showing brand markings, or a clip pairing it to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unbranded pads, not adding premium value

risks.risk: Cables shown (power, HDMI) may not be the correct or original cables for the specific region/model.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cable connectors and plug type matching the claimed unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base kit only, no premium for cabling

proof_requests: Rear panel or underside photo showing the model number/serial sticker to confirm PS4 Pro vs Slim/base.
Video of the console powered on, showing the system settings screen with model/firmware info.
Close-up of the controllers removed from the box to confirm brand and condition.
A clip of a game loading to confirm the console reads discs and functions.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly show the PS4 Pro's distinctive body or any model/serial marking, so the core claim that sets the price (Pro vs Slim/base) cannot even be priced at a worst case without a clearer shot of the rear/model sticker.
